name: veritrail
description: Veritrail — the trust & control plane for AI agents. A tamper-evident event ledger and eight governance engines: audit, rollback, permissions, spend guard, incident forensics, evidence tracing, decision memory, and vendor risk.

scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.ci: pnpm run verify && pnpm run build
scripts.setup:hooks: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo "Veritrail git hooks enabled (.githooks)."
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist .turbo node_modules/.cache && rm -rf node_modules
